page.title: Maps of Mayotte
page.lead: Free vector maps of Mayotte: outlines, administrative divisions, population and housing, relief, lagoon, vegetation, roads and footpaths, buildings and facilities, locator maps. Use them in any project, commercial ones included, without asking.
page.licence: Maps under CC0 1.0 (public domain), with the credit “Source: IGN” for those built on IGN data, plus “Source: Insee” for the population maps (see the bottom of the page). Code under MIT-0.
page.sources: Sources: IGN – Admin Express COG 2026, BD TOPO, BD ALTI (Licence Ouverte 2.0); Insee, 2017 population census; Copernicus Sentinel-2 of 2 September 2025; Natural Earth. Outlines, lagoon and locator maps carry no conditions; the other maps reuse IGN data: credit “Source: IGN” when you reuse them, and “Source: Insee, 2017 population census” for the population maps.
page.overlay: All island maps sharing a frame overlay pixel for pixel.

family.population.text: Population, density and sheet-metal housing in the 17 communes, from the 2017 census.
family.population.notice: These figures come from INSEE's 2017 census, taken before cyclone Chido. The 2025–2026 census counts 323,153 inhabitants on 1 January 2026; its figures by commune will be published with the decree at the end of 2026, and these maps will be updated then. Some local elected officials contest the 2026 total.
